articles.title: One Failed Exam Is Not a Verdict on Your Life
articles.titleHinglish: Ek Fail Hua Exam Aapki Zindagi Ka Faisla Nahi Hai
articles.content:
The result comes out and within an hour the story is finished: I am not good enough, everyone else was better, my life is now a lower version of what it could have been.

Slow down at exactly that step, because that is where the real damage happens. A failed exam is an event. Everything after the first sentence is interpretation, and interpretation is where a bad week becomes a bad decade.

Start with the mechanical truth. A competitive exam does not measure your worth or even your intelligence. It measures a specific performance, on one day, on a narrow set of questions, against a fixed number of seats. Someone with the same knowledge as you failed because of a fever, an unfamiliar question order, or an exam centre two hours away. Treating that as a statement about who you are is a category error, and it is a very expensive one.

That said, the opposite mistake is also common: pretending nothing can be learned. Most failures do contain information, and it is usually specific and boring. You did not revise the second half. You never practised under time pressure. You studied for recognition rather than recall. You worked eleven hours a day and slept five, so your memory could not consolidate anything. Those are all fixable, and none of them mean anything about your capacity.

So the useful exercise is to write two lists. What was in my control, and what was not. Be honest in both directions — most people either take responsibility for everything, which is despair, or for nothing, which is stagnation.

Then decide the next attempt on evidence rather than emotion. Give it a real deadline and a real plan, but also decide in advance what would make you stop. The most painful cases are not people who failed once. They are people who spent six years on attempt after attempt because stopping felt like admitting the earlier years were wasted. It is worth deciding now, while you can think clearly, what your limit is.

And one thing about the people around you. You will hear congratulations for your cousin all month. You will hear the comparison. Do not make decisions in that atmosphere; the sting is real, and it fades much faster than you expect. Most of the people whose judgement you fear will have moved on within weeks.

One last piece of perspective, and it is not consolation but a fact. Ask any group of forty-year-olds about the exam result that felt like the end of their life. Most of them will need a moment to remember which one you mean.
articles.contentHinglish:
Result aata hai aur ek ghante ke andar kahani poori ho jaati hai: main kaafi achha nahi hoon, baaki sab behtar the, ab meri zindagi uska ek chhota version hai jo ho sakti thi.

Theek us kadam par dheere ho jao, kyunki asli nuksaan wahin hota hai. Fail hua exam ek ghatna hai. Pehle sentence ke baad ka sab kuch vyakhya hai, aur vyakhya wahi jagah hai jahan ek kharab hafta ek kharab dashak ban jaata hai.

Mechanical sach se shuru karte hain. Competitive exam aapki keemat nahi naapta, na hi aapki buddhi. Wo ek khaas performance naapta hai — ek din, kuch ginne-chune sawaalon par, ek tay ginti ki seats ke khilaf. Aapke barabar knowledge wala koi isliye fail hua kyunki bukhaar tha, sawaalon ka kram anjaana tha, ya exam centre do ghante door tha. Ise apni pehchaan ka bayaan maan lena ek category ki galti hai, aur bahut mehngi.

Par ulti galti bhi utni hi aam hai: yeh dikhawa ki kuch seekhne ko hai hi nahi. Zyadatar asafaltaon mein information hoti hai, aur wo aksar specific aur boring hoti hai. Aapne doosra half revise nahi kiya. Aapne kabhi time pressure mein practice nahi ki. Aapne pehchaan ke liye padha, yaad karke likhne ke liye nahi. Aap gyarah ghante padhte the aur paanch ghante sote the, isliye memory kuch jama hi nahi kar payi. Yeh sab theek ho sakte hain, aur inme se koi bhi aapki kaabiliyat ke baare mein kuch nahi kehta.

Toh kaam ki exercise yeh hai ki do list banao. Kya mere haath mein tha, aur kya nahi. Dono taraf imaandaar raho — zyadatar log ya to har cheez ki zimmedari le lete hain, jo nirasha hai, ya kisi ki nahi, jo jamaav hai.

Phir agli koshish ka faisla emotion se nahi, saboot se karo. Use asli deadline aur asli plan do, par yeh bhi pehle se tay karo ki kis haalat mein aap rukoge. Sabse dukhad maamle wo nahi hain jo ek baar fail hue. Wo hain jinhone chhe saal koshish par koshish mein bitaye kyunki rukna yeh maan lena lagta tha ki pichhle saal barbaad ho gaye. Abhi tay kar lena behtar hai, jab dimaag saaf hai, ki aapki hadd kya hai.

Aur aas paas ke logon ke baare mein ek baat. Poora mahina aapko cousin ki badhai sunne ko milegi. Tulna sunne ko milegi. Us maahaul mein faisle mat lo; chubhan asli hai, aur wo aapki ummeed se bahut jaldi utar jaati hai. Jin logon ke faisle se aap darte ho, unme se zyadatar kuch hafton mein aage badh chuke honge.

Ek aakhri baat, jo tasalli nahi ek fact hai. Chaalis saal ke kisi bhi group se un exam result ke baare mein poochho jo unhe zindagi ka ant laga tha. Zyadatar ko yaad karne mein waqt lagega ki aap kaunse wale ki baat kar rahe ho.

articles.title: Choosing a Career When Everyone Has an Opinion
articles.titleHinglish: Career Chunna Jab Har Kisi Ki Raay Hai
articles.content:
Follow your passion is bad advice in most Indian contexts, and so is do whatever is safe. The first assumes you already know what you love and that it pays. The second assumes safety still exists in a job market that changes every five years.

Something more useful sits in between, and it comes down to three questions asked honestly.

What am I willing to be bad at for two years? Every field is unpleasant at the start. The question is not what excites you in a two-minute video, but which specific difficulty you can tolerate repeatedly — code that will not compile, patients who do not improve, clients who change their minds, students who do not listen. People survive on tolerance, not enthusiasm.

What does the daily work actually look like? Most career decisions are made from the title, not the work. Law is not courtroom speeches, it is drafting. Medicine is not diagnosis, it is fifteen years of exams and night duty. Design is not creating, it is revisions. Before choosing, find one person doing that job at three years in — not at fifteen — and ask them what their Tuesday looks like.

And what does it cost to leave? This is the question nobody asks and everybody should. Some paths are easy to exit — skills transfer, two years are not wasted. Others take a decade and leave you with a qualification that means nothing elsewhere. Choose the reversible option when you are unsure, because being unsure at twenty-one is normal and permanent decisions made in that state are expensive.

On the family pressure, which is the real subject for many people. Two things are worth separating. Their fear is usually about security, not about controlling you — they have seen instability and want you safe. Address the fear directly with a plan rather than arguing about the dream: here is what I will earn, here is my backup, here is when I will reassess. A plan calms people far more than passion does.

And give it a defined window. I want two years to try this, and if by then I have not reached X, I will do Y. That sentence has ended more family standoffs than any speech about following your heart, because it converts an unbounded fear into a bounded one.

One last thing. You will not get one perfect answer, and you do not need one. Almost nobody ends up where they planned at twenty. What matters far more than the first choice is whether you are learning something that compounds, and whether you can keep changing direction as you learn what the work is actually like.
articles.contentHinglish:
"Apne passion ko follow karo" zyadatar Indian haalat mein buri salaah hai, aur "jo safe hai wahi karo" bhi. Pehli maan kar chalti hai ki aapko pata hai aap kya pyaar karte ho aur usme paisa hai. Doosri maan kar chalti hai ki us job market mein abhi bhi surakhsha bachi hai jo har paanch saal mein badalti hai.

Zyada kaam ki cheez beech mein hai, aur wo teen imaandaar sawaalon par aati hai.

Main do saal tak kis cheez mein bura hone ko taiyaar hoon? Har field shuruaat mein bhaddhi hoti hai. Sawaal yeh nahi ki do minute ke video mein kya excite karta hai, balki yeh ki kaunsi khaas mushkil aap baar baar jhel sakte ho — code jo compile nahi hota, mareez jo theek nahi hote, client jo mann badalte rehte hain, students jo sunte nahi. Log jhelne ki kshamta par tikte hain, josh par nahi.

Rozana ka kaam sach mein dikhta kaisa hai? Zyadatar career faisle post ke naam se liye jaate hain, kaam se nahi. Law adaalat ke bhaashan nahi hai, drafting hai. Medicine diagnosis nahi hai, pandrah saal ke exams aur night duty hai. Design banana nahi hai, revisions hai. Chunne se pehle us kaam mein teen saal wale ek insaan ko dhoondho — pandrah saal wale ko nahi — aur poochho ki unka Tuesday kaisa hota hai.

Aur chhodne ki keemat kya hai? Yeh sawaal koi nahi poochhta aur sabko poochhna chahiye. Kuch raaste chhodne mein aasaan hain — skills transfer ho jaati hain, do saal bekaar nahi jaate. Kuch mein ek dashak lagta hai aur ant mein aisi degree bachti hai jiska kahin aur koi matlab nahi. Jab yakeen na ho to wo option chuno jise palta ja sake, kyunki ikkis ki umar mein yakeen na hona normal hai aur us haalat mein liye gaye permanent faisle mehnge padte hain.

Ghar ke pressure par, jo bahut logon ke liye asli mudda hai. Do cheezein alag karne laayak hain. Unka dar aksar surakhsha ka hota hai, aap par control ka nahi — unhone astirata dekhi hai aur wo aapko safe chahte hain. Us dar ka jawab sapne par bahas karke nahi, plan se do: itna kamaunga, yeh mera backup hai, itne waqt baad main dobara jaanchunga. Plan logon ko passion se kahin zyada shaant karta hai.

Aur ek tay window do. "Mujhe do saal chahiye ise try karne ke liye, aur agar tab tak X nahi hua to main Y karunga." Is line ne "dil ki suno" wale kisi bhi bhaashan se zyada gharelu takraav khatam kiye hain, kyunki yeh bina hadd wale dar ko hadd wala dar bana deti hai.

Ek aakhri baat. Aapko ek perfect jawab nahi milega, aur zaroorat bhi nahi hai. Lagbhag koi wahan nahi pahunchta jahan usne bees ki umar mein socha tha. Pehle faisle se kahin zyada mayne yeh rakhta hai ki aap aisa kuch seekh rahe ho jo jud kar badhta hai, aur yeh ki jaise jaise kaam ki asli shakal samajh aaye, aap disha badalte reh sakte ho ya nahi.

articles.title: Everyone Else Looks Ahead of You. Here Is Why
articles.titleHinglish: Sab Aage Dikhte Hain. Wajah Yeh Hai
articles.content:
Your batchmate posted about a promotion. Someone from school is abroad. A junior is earning more than you. And you are sitting with the specific, sour feeling that you have fallen behind a schedule nobody ever gave you.

A few facts are worth putting next to that feeling.

You are seeing announcements, not lives. Nobody posts the rejection, the two years of stagnation, the loan taken to fund the move, the job that looks impressive and is destroying them. Comparing your full inside knowledge to everyone else's press release will always produce the same verdict, no matter how well you are doing.

Careers are not a single race. The junior earning more may be in a field that pays early and plateaus at thirty-five. The friend abroad may be five years from a return with no savings. The person promoted may have accepted a role they cannot leave. These are different games with different scoring, and treating them as one ranking is what makes the comparison feel so exact and so wrong.

And timing is mostly luck. Which sector was hiring the year you graduated, whether your manager fought for you, whether your company got funding — none of that was skill. People who do well are usually good and lucky, and the ones who insist it was all skill are simply not counting.

What helps, practically.

Change the unit of measurement. Instead of position relative to others, use capability relative to yourself. What can I do now that I could not do eighteen months ago? If the answer is nothing, that is real information and worth acting on — and it is a far more useful signal than someone else's promotion.

Cut the feed when it is doing damage. Not forever. But during a hard stretch, watching the highlight reel of two hundred acquaintances is not information, it is self-harm with good production values.

Use envy as a pointer, then discard it. Envy is oddly useful once you interrogate it. Do you actually want their job, or do you want to feel respected? Do you want to move abroad, or do you want to escape your current manager? The specific answer usually points at something achievable that has nothing to do with them.

And hold on to the long view. Most careers are thirty-five years long. The gaps that feel enormous at twenty-six — two years, one promotion, a first salary — are close to invisible at forty. Almost nobody arrives on schedule, and the schedule was imaginary anyway.
articles.contentHinglish:
Aapke batchmate ne promotion ki post daali. School ka koi videsh mein hai. Ek junior aapse zyada kama raha hai. Aur aap us khatti si feeling ke saath baithe ho ki aap kisi aise schedule se peeche reh gaye ho jo aapko kisi ne diya hi nahi tha.

Us feeling ke bagal mein kuch facts rakhne laayak hain.

Aap announcements dekh rahe ho, zindagiyan nahi. Koi rejection post nahi karta, na do saal ka jamaav, na wo loan jo shift karne ke liye liya, na wo job jo dikhne mein zabardast hai aur unhe kha rahi hai. Apni poori andar ki jaankari ki tulna doosron ki press release se karoge to nateeja hamesha wahi aayega, chahe aap kitna bhi achha kar rahe ho.

Career ek hi race nahi hai. Zyada kamaane wala junior shayad us field mein hai jo shuru mein deta hai aur paitees par ruk jaata hai. Videsh wala dost shayad paanch saal baad bina bachat ke laut aayega. Promotion wale ne shayad wo role le liya hai jise wo chhod nahi sakte. Yeh alag khel hain jinke scoring alag hain, aur inhe ek ranking maan lena hi wo cheez hai jo comparison ko itna theek aur itna galat bana deti hai.

Aur timing zyadatar kismat hai. Jis saal aapne padhai poori ki us saal kaunsa sector hire kar raha tha, aapke manager ne aapke liye lada ya nahi, aapki company ko funding mili ya nahi — inme se kuch bhi skill nahi tha. Jo log achha karte hain wo aksar achhe bhi hote hain aur kismat wale bhi, aur jo zid karte hain ki sab skill thi wo bas gin nahi rahe.

Practically kya madad karta hai.

Naapne ki ikaai badlo. Doosron ke saapeksh position ki jagah, khud ke saapeksh kaabiliyat lo. Aaj main kya kar sakta hoon jo atharah mahine pehle nahi kar sakta tha? Agar jawab "kuch nahi" hai, to yeh asli information hai aur uspar kaam karna chahiye — aur yeh kisi aur ke promotion se kahin zyada kaam ka signal hai.

Jab feed nuksaan kar rahi ho to use kaat do. Hamesha ke liye nahi. Par mushkil daur mein do sau jaan-pehchaan walon ka highlight reel dekhna information nahi hai, wo achhe production value wali khud ki chot hai.

Jalan ko ishaare ki tarah istemaal karo, phir phenk do. Sawaal poochho to jalan ajeeb tarah se kaam ki nikalti hai. Kya aapko sach mein unki job chahiye, ya aapko izzat mehsoos karni hai? Kya aapko videsh jaana hai, ya apne manager se bachna hai? Specific jawab aksar kisi aise kaam ki taraf ishaara karta hai jo mumkin hai aur jiska unse koi lena dena nahi.

Aur lambi nazar pakde raho. Zyadatar career paitees saal lambe hote hain. Jo faasle chhabbis ki umar mein bahut bade lagte hain — do saal, ek promotion, pehli salary — wo chaalis par lagbhag dikhte hi nahi. Lagbhag koi bhi schedule par nahi pahunchta, aur schedule waise bhi kaalpanik tha.
